name: visible and invisible users with two satellites
test:
import math

def check_feasible(users, satellites, links):
    assert isinstance(links, dict)
    assert set(links).issubset(users)
    by_satellite = {sid: [] for sid in satellites}
    for uid, (sid, frequency) in links.items():
        assert sid in satellites and frequency in (1, 2, 3, 4)
        user = users[uid]
        satellite = satellites[sid]
        sight = tuple(satellite[i] - user[i] for i in range(3))
        outward_dot = sum(user[i] * sight[i] for i in range(3))
        angle = math.degrees(math.acos(max(-1.0, min(1.0, outward_dot / (math.dist(user, (0, 0, 0)) * math.dist(user, satellite))))))
        assert angle <= 45 + 1e-8
        by_satellite[sid].append((uid, frequency))
    for sid, assignments in by_satellite.items():
        assert len(assignments) <= 32
        satellite = satellites[sid]
        for i, (first, first_freq) in enumerate(assignments):
            for second, second_freq in assignments[i + 1:]:
                beam_a = tuple(users[first][j] - satellite[j] for j in range(3))
                beam_b = tuple(users[second][j] - satellite[j] for j in range(3))
                cosine = sum(beam_a[j] * beam_b[j] for j in range(3)) / (math.dist(users[first], satellite) * math.dist(users[second], satellite))
                separation = math.degrees(math.acos(max(-1.0, min(1.0, cosine))))
                if separation < 10 - 1e-8:
                    assert first_freq != second_freq

users = {'north': (0, 0, 1), 'south': (0, 0, -1), 'equator': (1, 0, 0)}
satellites = {'N': (0, 0, 2), 'S': (0, 0, -2)}
links = assign_links(users, satellites)
check_feasible(users, satellites, links)
assert links['north'][0] == 'N'
assert links['south'][0] == 'S'
assert 'equator' not in links
